name: Bihar BPSC TRE 4.0 (School Teacher Recruitment Examination)

conducting_body.name: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC), Patna
conducting_body.headquarters: 15, Jawahar Lal Nehru Marg (Bailey Road), Patna, Bihar 800001

official_sources.name: Bihar School Teacher Recruitment Examination (TRE 4.0) Official Notification & Syllabus 2026
Education Department, Government of Bihar Service Rules & Teacher Guidelines

parts.qualifying_criteria: Minimum 30% marks (9 marks out of 30) required to qualify.

parts.part: Part III - Concerned Subject / Specialized Discipline & Pedagogy (संबंधित विषय / विशिष्ट विषय एवं शिक्षण शास्त्र)

components.name: Subject Knowledge / Core General Studies (Primary 1-5) or Specialized Subject (Middle 6-8, Secondary 9-10, Higher Secondary 11-12)

subjects.name: General Studies, Indian National Movement & Bihar Special GK (सामान्य अध्ययन, भारतीय राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन एवं बिहार विशेष)
domains: Indian National Movement 1857-1947: Revolt of 1857 (Kunwar Singh, Pir Ali), Champaran Satyagraha 1917 (Raj Kumar Shukla), Non-Cooperation Movement, Civil Disobedience Movement, Quit India Movement 1942 (Secretariat Firing, Azad Dasta, Jayaprakash Narayan)
Bihar History & Freedom Struggle: Kisan Sabha (Swami Sahajanand Saraswati), Dr. Rajendra Prasad, Mazharul Haque (Sadaqat Ashram), Maulana Shaukat Ali, Anugrah Narayan Sinha

Ancient and Medieval Bihar: Magadha Empire, Mauryan Dynasty (Chandragupta, Ashoka, Rock Edicts), Nalanda & Vikramshila Universities, Pala Dynasty, Sher Shah Suri's administration and mausoleum at Sasaram

Bihar Geography, Climate & Physical Features: River Systems (Ganga, Son, Gandak, Kosi, Ghaghara, Punpun), Soil types (Bangar, Khadar, Terai), Forest cover, Protected areas (Valmiki National Park, Kaimur, Kanwar Jheel), Mineral resources

Bihar Polity, Governance & Schemes: Legislative Assembly and Council structure, Panchayati Raj System (50% reservation for women in Panchayats), Seven Resolves (Saat Nischay-1 & Saat Nischay-2), Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal, Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana

Bihar Economy, Demographics & Current Affairs: Census 2011 figures (literacy, sex ratio, density, decadal growth), Economic Survey of Bihar highlights, State budget priorities, Agrarian sectors and GI tags (Shahi Litchi, Katarni Rice, Magahi Paan, Mithila Makhana)

subjects.name: Language Qualifying - General English & Hindi Grammar (भाषा अर्हता - सामान्य अंग्रेजी एवं हिन्दी व्याकरण)
domains: English Grammar & Usage: Parts of Speech (Nouns, Pronouns, Adjectives, Adverbs, Prepositions, Conjunctions), Subject-Verb Agreement, Tenses, Modals
English Sentence Mechanics: Active and Passive Voice, Direct and Indirect Speech, Sentence Transformation, Spotting Errors, Sentence Improvement
English Vocabulary: Synonyms, Antonyms, Idioms and Phrases, One-word Substitution, Spellings, Phrasal Verbs, Reading Comprehension
Hindi Vyakaran: वर्ण विचार (स्वर, व्यंजन, उच्चारण स्थान), संधि (स्वर संधि, व्यंजन संधि, विसर्ग संधि), समास (छह भेद - अव्ययीभाव, तत्पुरुष, कर्मधारय, द्विगु, द्वंद्व, बहुव्रीहि)
Hindi Shabda Rachna: उपसर्ग, प्रत्यय, शब्द भेद (तत्सम, तद्भव, देशज, विदेशज, संकर), शब्द रूप, संज्ञा, सर्वनाम, विशेषण, क्रिया, काल, कारक, लिंग, वचन
Hindi Bhasha Vyavahar: पर्यायवाची शब्द, विलोम शब्द, अनेकार्थी शब्द, वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द, मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां, शुद्ध-अशुद्ध वर्तनी, वाक्य शुद्धि, अपठित गद्यांश

subjects.name: Elementary Mathematics, Quantitative Aptitude & Mental Ability (प्रारंभिक गणित एवं तर्कशक्ति)
domains: Number Systems & Fundamentals: Divisibility rules, Prime numbers, LCM & HCF, Fractions, Decimals, Surds & Indices, Simplification (BODMAS rule)
Commercial Arithmetic: Percentage, Profit, Loss and Discount, Simple Interest and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion, Partnership, Mixtures and Alligations
Applied Mathematics: Time and Work, Pipes and Cisterns, Time, Speed and Distance, Trains, Boats and Streams, Average, Age calculation problems

Algebra & Mensuration: Basic algebraic identities, Linear equations in one/two variables, Quadratic equations, 2D Area & Perimeter (Triangles, Rectangles, Trapeziums, Circles), 3D Volume & Surface Area (Cylinders, Cones, Spheres, Cubes)
Statistics & Probability: Mean, Median, Mode, Range, Basic probability concepts
Verbal Reasoning: Number and Alphabet Series, Analogies, Classification / Odd One Out, Coding-Decoding, Blood Relations, Direction Sense Test, Syllogisms, Ranking & Order
Non-Verbal & Analytical Reasoning: Venn Diagrams, Mathematical operators, Pattern completion, Figure series, Logical deduction

subjects.name: General Science, Social Studies & Teaching Pedagogy (सामान्य विज्ञान, सामाजिक अध्ययन एवं शिक्षण अभिरुचि)
domains: Physical Sciences (Physics): Laws of Motion, Work, Power & Energy, Gravitation, Heat and Temperature, Reflection and Refraction of Light, Human Eye, Sound, Electric Current & Circuits, Magnetic Effects

Chemical Sciences (Chemistry): Matter and its states, Elements, Compounds and Mixtures, Atomic Structure, Acids, Bases and Salts, Chemical Reactions and Equations, Metals and Non-metals, Carbon and its Compounds

Life Sciences (Biology): Cell Structure and Functions, Plant and Animal Tissues, Human Physiology (Digestive, Respiratory, Circulatory, Excretory, Nervous Systems), Plant Physiology (Photosynthesis, Transpiration), Genetics, Diseases and Immunity, Vitamins & Nutrition
Ecology & Environment: Ecosystem components, Food chains and Food webs, Biodiversity Conservation, Environmental Pollution, Global Warming, Natural Resources

Social Studies & Indian Polity: Constitution of India (Preamble, Fundamental Rights, DPSPs, Fundamental Duties), Union Executive & Legislature, Judiciary, State Government, Panchayati Raj System, Indian Geography (Physical divisions, Monsoon, Rivers, Soils, Agriculture)

Educational Pedagogy & Teaching Aptitude: Child-centered teaching methods (Inductive, Deductive, Project, Heuristic), Classroom communication, Assessment for Learning, Evaluation techniques, Continuous Comprehensive Evaluation (CCE), National Education Policy (NEP 2020), Inclusive education strategies

master_bundled_notes.title: BPSC TRE Master Bundle 1: Indian National Movement & Bihar's Historic Role (1857-1947)
master_bundled_notes.focus: 1857 revolt, Babu Kunwar Singh, Champaran Satyagraha, Kisan Sabha, Swami Sahajanand Saraswati, Quit India Movement 1942, Secretariat Martyrs, Azad Dasta, Jayaprakash Narayan

master_bundled_notes.title: BPSC TRE Master Bundle 2: Bihar Geography, River Systems, Demographics & Economic Survey
master_bundled_notes.focus: Ganga & tributaries, Bihar agro-climatic zones, soils, mineral belts, Census 2011, Saat Nischay-1 & 2 flagship schemes, Bihar Economic Survey and State Budget

master_bundled_notes.title: BPSC TRE Master Bundle 3: Language Qualifying - General English & Hindi Grammar Mastery
master_bundled_notes.focus: Part I qualifying threshold, English active/passive voice, prepositions, vocabulary, Hindi संधि, समास, कारक, तत्सम-तद्भव, वर्तनी एवं वाक्य शुद्धि

master_bundled_notes.title: BPSC TRE Master Bundle 4: Elementary Mathematics, Quantitative Aptitude & Mental Ability Simulation
master_bundled_notes.focus: Number systems, arithmetic (percentage, profit-loss, time-work, speed-distance), algebra, mensuration, coding-decoding, series, syllogisms and direction tests

master_bundled_notes.title: BPSC TRE Master Bundle 5: General Science, Social Studies, Polity & Educational Pedagogy
master_bundled_notes.focus: Physics, chemistry, biology, environmental ecology, Indian Constitution & Polity, pedagogical methodologies, classroom assessment and NEP 2020 framework
